g.text: check type, size limit and storage quota
The file goes straight to storage, so the
API servers never handle the bytes. The
signed URL fixes the object key, the size,
the content type and a 15-minute lifetime.
HEAD object, compare size and sha256
check that the album belongs to the owner
check magic bytes, scan for malware,
mark the album item as rejected
in AVIF and WebP, plus OG_1200 JPEG
mark the album item as READY
